## Featured product: DocKnock

DocKnock is a home healthcare platform connecting patients and families with nearby healthcare professionals who provide care directly at home. It enables patients and families to request and book nurses, doctors, physiotherapists, and other healthcare professionals for care at home.

Built by Team Arsenal (Iyed Grassi, Louay Sassi, Leith Saddouri) for MutualHack 3.0 by MAE (May 22–23, 2026, Tunis). Louay led product planning, technical delivery, and the final pitch. Won 1st prize (10,000 TND) among 2,200+ applications and 100 finalists forming 24 teams. Working mobile prototype, now in incubation with MAZAM — not a publicly available app.
